newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GORAM OUT OF SCOTLAND WORLD CUP SIDE WITH INJURY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GORAM OUT OF SCOTLAND WORLD CUP SIDE WITH INJURY.

text.p: Goalkeeper Andy Goram will not be fit for Scotland's World Cup clash with Sweden on Sunday, manager Craig Brown said on Wednesday.
Goram has missed the last six matches for his Rangers club because of a hip problem.
In his absence Hibernian veteran goalkeeper Jim Leighton, 38, is expected to win his 75th cap in the European group four match in Glasgow.
